overview: Lady Ophelia is the dramatic, morbid, darkly funny ghost of Hollowmere Manor, who died after waiting all night at her debutante ball for a suitor who never came. Keep showing up for her, and use your Wits to uncover what really happened that night.
tips: Her favourite gift is a Bouquet of Roses; she also likes an Imported Tea Set, a Pearl Comb, a Steamy Romance Novel and Silver Lute Strings. Avoid holy things (Blessed Candle, Saintly Relic) and the Gilded Hand Mirror.
She can only be found at Hollowmere Manor in the evening, so plan your evenings around her.
Take her to Sunset at Saltbreeze Harbor, her favourite date. Wits is her stat (Wits 2 for Romance Scene II, Wits 3 for Scene III).
The Debutante, Belatedly takes priority over her other endings: if you set it up, you get it automatically.

endings.title: A Heartbeat at Starfall
endings.summary: On the manor roof, far from the festival, you tell Ophelia the stars' binding counts for the dead too. The goddess sends a star straight into her chest, and she has a heartbeat again. You restore Hollowmere together, and she eats cake for breakfast for a month. It's the tender second-chance-at-life ending.
howTo: Don't set up The Debutante, Belatedly (see below), or you'll get that ending instead.
This is the default ending otherwise. On the roof, choose "Lay your hand as near to hers as it will go. 'I think it counts.'"

endings.title: Haunted by You
endings.summary: Offered a wish, Ophelia skips the tidy ending: she doesn't want to stop haunting, only to stop haunting a house. The star binds her to your locket instead, and she follows you everywhere: travelling, critiquing fashions, frosting rude people's soup. She stays a ghost, and you become the most thoroughly haunted person in the kingdom.
howTo: Don't set up The Debutante, Belatedly (see below), or you'll get that ending instead.
Do any one of: in First Meeting, choose "That was a beautiful wail. Very haunting."; or in The Morning After, choose "Haunt me all you like."
On the roof, choose "Make a wish, Ophelia. On the brightest one. Anything you like."

endings.title: The Debutante, Belatedly
endings.summary: The festival comes to Hollowmere: Ophelia descends the staircase where she once waited all night, and this time you're waiting at the bottom. Mid-waltz, a star falls through the broken dome and makes her alive. She becomes Clichéton's most scandalous hostess, and she never sits out a dance again.
howTo: Chosen automatically at Starfall (no final choice needed) if you've done any one of the following:
In The Morning After, choose "Next time there's a ball in this house, it's yours. Every dance. I promise."
Or do both of: in First Meeting, pass "Notice the dust sheets — she's set a table for two" (Wits check 1), and in Romance Scene I, pass "Ask her to teach you the old dances" (Wits check 2).
